card.name: The word program in restricted-access (REMS) statements
card.fires_on: The word "program" right after "available only through a restricted" in drug label REMS statements. A weaker case is "including" after a poverty-rate figure in census-style text.

modes.label: Restricted program (REMS)
modes.description: "program" completes the phrase "available only through a restricted" before "under a REMS" or "called the ... REMS".
modes.example: of ZENBEXUS therapy. 5.2 ZENBEXUS REMS ZENBEXUS is available only through a restricted<< program>> called ZENBEXUS REMS

modes.label: Poverty statistics
modes.description: "including" after a poverty-line percentage in demographic text.
modes.example: 23,251. About 6.5% of families and 9.8% of the population were below the poverty line,<< including>> 14.5% of those

card.plain: It lights up on the word "program" in the standard sentence saying a drug is available only through a restricted program.
evidence: MYALEPT is available only through a restricted<< program>> called the MYALEPT REMS PROGRAM
lenalidomide capsules are available only through a restricted<< program>> under a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy
Because of the risk of QT prolongation, VANFLYTA is available only through a restricted<< program>> under a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy
